en: Dependent on a state that is not-clung-to-but-subservient-to-clinging, a state that is not-clung-to-but-subservient-to-clinging arises by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is neither-clung-to-nor-subservient-to-clinging, a state that is neither-clung-to-nor-subservient-to-clinging arises by way of root condition … five.
Dependent on a state that is neither-clung-to-nor-subservient-to-clinging, a state that is clung-to-and-subservient-to-clinging arises by way of root condition … three.

Dependent on states that are neither-clung-to-nor-liable-to-clinging and neither-not-clung-to-nor-not-liable-to-clinging, a state that is not-clung-to-but-liable-to-clinging arises by way of root-condition … one.

Dependent on states that are neither-not-clung-to-nor-not-liable-to-clinging and neither-clung-to-nor-liable-to-clinging, a state that is clung-to-and-liable-to-clinging arises by way of root-condition … three.

Dependent on states that are neither-clung-to-nor-liable-to-clinging and neither-not-clung-to-nor-not-liable-to-clinging, a state that is neither-clung-to-nor-not-liable-to-clinging arises by way of root-condition … three. (Abbreviated.)

With respect to the root condition, there are eighteen; with respect to the object condition, nine; with respect to the predominance condition, eleven ... pe ... with respect to the repetition condition, six ... pe ... with respect to the resultant condition, seventeen ... pe ... with respect to the non-disappearance condition, eighteen.
